classification.classification_reason: The article is about a controversial event at Oxford University involving Nathan Cofnas, a race realist, and protests against his appearance.

content.title: Hundreds protest against Nathan Cofnas talk on DEI at Oriel College in Oxford
content.caption: Students oppose appearance of self-described 'race realist' who made plagiarism claims against Jason Arday

slides.heading: Hundreds protest against Nathan Cofnas talk on DEI at Oriel
slides.text: Students oppose appearance of self-described 'race realist' who made plagiarism claims against Jason Arday

slides.heading: What happened?
slides.text: The Reform UK student society organised an event billed as 'An evening with Nathan Cofnas: is DEI undermining higher education?' despite opposition from students, college staff, and local politicians.

slides.heading: Why does it matter?
slides.text: The event went ahead despite opposition, with students, college staff, and local politicians concerned about the appearance creating a hostile environment.
